Archived files using them cannot be re-validated against the newer schema.

## Reproducer recipe

AP214 file using `kinematic_link_representation_relation` re-headered as AP242; or Ed.2 file with `vertex_on_edge` re-validated against Ed.3.

## Expected kernel behavior
